title: VendPoint Substitute Placement Par — Calculation
content:
Calculation of the par at which Corbett places a substitute in a retired item's selection on a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine.

**The two items.** The retired item is the item of the customer's contract price line written as a removal carrying the highest change reference on the customer's agreement, and its substitute is the item of the customer's contract price line written as a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item carrying the highest change reference (both are change lines, whose references Corbett issues in sequence).

**Counting months.** Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

**The retired item's units.** The retired item's units are its units vended from the machine in the three months ending today, less its units returned to the machine or credited for a vend error in the same three months, each record counted by its date.

**The standard par.** The standard par is the retired item's par, the par on the retired item's selection entry carrying the highest planogram request reference.

**The par.** To fix the substitute's par, each method that applies first replaces the quantity of the standard par it names; the standard par is then multiplied by one plus the allowance that applies and by each share and factor that applies, and the product is rounded up to a whole unit only at the end.

### Hypothetical figures

| Retired item's selection entries (by planogram request reference) | Retired item's par | Standard par |
|---|---|---|
| Add at 12, then par change to 18 | 18 (the entry with the highest reference) | 18 units |
| Add at 30 only | 30 | 30 units |

Units window, hypothetical dates with today 20 May: a vend dated 21 February is inside the three months ending today; one dated 20 February is not. The figures are invented.
